aggregators.name: GoCardless Bank Account Data (ex-Nordigen)
aggregators.cost: No new sign-ups since July 2025. Existing accounts keep working on their old terms.
setup_steps: Existing accounts only: log in at bankaccountdata.gocardless.com
Create a user secret and save the secret ID and secret key
Enter the secret ID and key in the dashboard
Pick your bank and approve access in the bank's app
Reconnect every 90 days
aggregators.notes: The official page bankaccountdata.gocardless.com/new-signups-disabled says 'New signups for Bank Account Data are currently disabled'. Actual Budget's docs date this to July 2025. Before closing it covered UK and EEA bank accounts: balances and transactions only, no investment holdings. Docs promise up to 90 days of access and up to 24 months of history. Some banks allow only 4 calls a day per account.

aggregators.name: Enable Banking
aggregators.cost: Free. The Terms (updated 9 Jan 2026) allow production use only for accounts you link yourself, for the personal use of private individuals. The number of linked accounts per app may be limited.
setup_steps: Sign in at enablebanking.com/sign-in with your email (no password: you get a one-time link; the account is created on first sign-in)
Open API applications (enablebanking.com/cp/applications) and add a new application. Choose Production and keep the key made by your browser

Fill in the form: a name, and as redirect URL the address shown below, exactly. If it also asks for a description, data protection email, privacy policy and terms links, fill those in (links start with https://)
Click Register. Your browser downloads the private key: a .pem file named after the application ID
The new application shows as Inactive. Click 'Activate by linking accounts' and approve each bank account you want to track (the free restricted mode reads only these accounts)
Below, enter the application ID and choose the .pem file
Pick your bank and approve access once more at the bank (Enable Banking asks for this even for accounts you linked)
Renew when the bank access ends (180 days at most banks, less at some). The app warns you 14 days before
aggregators.notes: Restricted mode can only read accounts you linked in the Control Panel. It covers EEA banks in 30 countries; the markets list does not include the UK. It reads PSD2 payment accounts only (balances and transactions), not investment holdings. The FAQ says consent is 180 days for most banks; each bank sets its own maximum (GET /aspsps maximum_consent_validity). Many banks allow only 4 background reads a day, so the app reads balances every 6 hours, or when you press Refresh. The redirect URL must be https, so link banks from the dashboard's https address (e.g. on Render).

aggregators.name: TrueLayer
aggregators.cost: Sandbox is free. Live access is only for registered businesses that pass onboarding; pricing goes through sales.
setup_steps: Not possible for personal use: TrueLayer's help centre says live access is refused for personal or hobby projects, even ones that only connect your own accounts
aggregators.notes: Strong UK coverage (Starling, Monzo, Revolut, Wise, Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds, Nationwide). UK rules make the app reconfirm consent every 90 days. Covers bank and card balances and transactions only; no investments.

aggregators.name: Plaid
aggregators.cost: Free Trial plan (since 15 Apr 2026): real data, up to 10 Items, but only for developers in the US or Canada and only for US/Canadian institutions. Everyone else needs paid Production.
setup_steps: US/Canada developers only: sign up at dashboard.plaid.com/signup
Pass identity verification and accept the Plaid Master Services Agreement
Copy the client ID and the production secret from the dashboard
Connect each institution through Plaid Link in a browser
Exchange the public token for an access token and store it
aggregators.notes: Not available to a UK-based user. The Trial plan includes Investments (holdings and investment transactions), Transactions, Balance, Liabilities and almost all OAuth institutions (Bank of America, Chase, Wells Fargo, Merrill, and more). The 10-Item cap is permanent: removing an Item does not free its slot. US Items have no fixed renewal period; individual OAuth banks may expire consent.

aggregators.name: SnapTrade
aggregators.cost: SnapTrade Personal is free with no card: up to 20 brokerage connections and one personal client ID and consumer key. The commercial free Build plan is separate (5 connections).
setup_steps: Sign up for SnapTrade Personal at snaptrade.com/personal
Connect your brokerage accounts in the SnapTrade dashboard
Create your Personal client ID and consumer key in the dashboard
Enter the client ID and consumer key in the dashboard; no user registration or user secret is needed
aggregators.notes: Brokerages only. Reads balances, positions, transactions (activities) and orders. Live broker list (checked 2026-11-14) includes Trading 212, DEGIRO, BUX, eToro, AJ Bell, IBKR, Fidelity, Schwab, Vanguard US, Robinhood, E*TRADE, Webull, Public, Alpaca, Chase, Wells Fargo. DEGIRO, BUX, AJ Bell, Vanguard US, Webull and XTB use an unofficial API (SnapTrade logs in with your broker credentials), which carries a terms-of-service risk. Not covered: Trade Republic, Saxo, Hargreaves Lansdown, interactive investor, Vanguard UK, Freetrade, IG, Fidelity UK, InvestEngine, Lightyear, Bitvavo, Revolut, Merrill, SoFi. No fixed renewal period; reconnect when a broker session breaks. Sources disagree on the limit (20 personal vs 5 on the commercial free plan), and docs do not say whether 'after broker approval' brokers (Fidelity, Schwab, Chase, Wells Fargo) work on personal keys.

aggregators.name: Salt Edge
aggregators.cost: New clients start in Pending (fake banks only). Test status allows 100 live connections for 90 days and needs company details. Live requires legal and technical review and a paid plan; third-party sources say from about $500/month.
setup_steps: Not practical for personal use: sign up, then provide company details, app details and callback URLs to request Test access
Test access lapses after 90 days; Live needs a compliance review and payment
aggregators.notes: Built for companies; the docs define a client as a legal entity. Claims 5,000+ institutions in 50+ countries, including investment accounts, but no public coverage list was found for the institutions in scope. The 90-day consent period is assumed from PSD2 and was not confirmed in Salt Edge docs.

aggregators.name: SimpleFIN Bridge (extra, North America)
aggregators.cost: $1.50/month or $15/year plus tax; up to 25 institutions and 25 apps.
setup_steps: Create a SimpleFIN Bridge account and pay
Connect your US or Canadian institutions in the Bridge
Create a setup token for the app and paste it into the dashboard
The dashboard swaps the token once for a permanent access URL
aggregators.notes: Not one of the six requested; added because Actual Budget uses it for North America. Only the price and limits are confirmed. Coverage (US/Canada banks, some brokerages) and the setup-token flow are from Actual Budget docs and memory, not checked against SimpleFIN's institution search. Irrelevant for UK/NL accounts.

methods.notes: SnapTrade Personal (free) uses an UNOFFICIAL_API connector here: it logs in with your broker username, password and 2FA. Read-only. Terms-of-service and security risk.

steps: Log in to the DEGIRO web platform
Click Inbox in the left menu (app: Inbox, bottom right)
Open Account overview (Rekeningoverzicht)
Set the Start date to your first trade and the End date to today (the default is one month)
Click Export and choose CSV
methods.notes: All cash movements: buys/sells, dividends, dividend tax, fees, deposits. Also XLS/PDF. Column headers follow the platform language and amounts may use decimal commas (importer reports, not official). DEGIRO has no official API. The PDF of the same account statement works too; each trade is checked against the amount DEGIRO booked.

steps: Log in to the DEGIRO web platform
Click Inbox in the left menu
Open Transactions (Transactieoverzicht)
Set Start date and End date
Click Export and choose CSV
methods.notes: Buys and sells only, with fees; no dividends. Default range is one month.

steps: Open Portfolio on the DEGIRO web platform
Click Export on the right
Pick a date and choose CSV
methods.notes: Open positions on the chosen date, valued at the last closing price. App: tap the down-arrow icon.
Reverse-engineered Python client for DEGIRO's private web API. Needs your username, password and TOTP 2FA secret stored on the server; not supported by DEGIRO, may break or breach the terms of use.

steps: Check that the Trade Republic app on your phone is up to date and may show notifications.
Enter the phone number of your Trade Republic account, with the country code (for example +49), and your PIN.
Open the Trade Republic app and confirm the sign-in. If you use an authenticator app, first enter its 6-digit code here.
That's it. Positions and cash update every few minutes. Your full history is read in the background (a few minutes the first time).
methods.notes: Unofficial: Trade Republic has no public API. This uses the same sign-in as Trade Republic's web app (app.traderepublic.com), like the open-source tool pytr, and does not log your phone out. Your PIN is sent to Trade Republic once and never stored; the app keeps only the sign-in session, on your own computer (encrypted in the backup vault). Read-only: the app has no code to trade, move money or change settings. It may stop working when Trade Republic changes its app, and using it may be against Trade Republic's terms: you decide. When Trade Republic ends the session, you sign in again; the dashboard keeps the last data meanwhile.

steps: Open the Trade Republic app
Tap Profile
Open Account statements
Tap Transaction export
Choose All transactions or a period
Tap Create and save the CSV
methods.notes: Added April 2026; one file covers the securities account and the cash account, including crypto. Reported to be in the web app too from 15 Apr 2026. No positions file: holdings are rebuilt from the trades. German label: Kontoauszüge > Transaktionsexport. The account statement PDF works too. If you also sign in, the sign-in takes over once it has read your history (only if it is the same account); the file stays as a fallback.

Free in restricted mode (accounts you link yourself). PSD2 payment accounts only: balances and transactions, no investments. Clearing/cash account only, not the securities depot. Enable Banking notes (Aug 2026) the bank's PSD2 API returns only amount, currency and booking date per transaction, with no description. Not needed if you sign in to Trade Republic in the app: the sign-in already reads your cash, and linking both counts it twice.
GoCardless: existing accounts only (no new sign-ups since July 2025). Coverage for this bank was not re-checked.

steps: Create a developer account on developer.saxo
Create a SIM app and test it (the 24-hour portal token works in SIM only)
Make sure your live Saxo account is funded
In the developer portal open Apps > Live Apps
Link your SIM developer account to your live account and log in
Click Request LIVE app, accept the disclaimers and fill in the form
Copy the App Key and App Secret into the dashboard
Sign in with Saxo once in the browser to authorise
methods.notes: Saxo allows direct retail clients to use OpenAPI for personal use; approval is usually automatic. Tokens are short-lived (sample responses: access 20 min, refresh 40-60 min), so the dashboard must keep refreshing or the user logs in again. Apps are not read-only scoped; only call GET endpoints. Eligibility for Saxo NL (ex-BinckBank) clients not confirmed.

steps: Log in to SaxoInvestor or SaxoTraderGO on the web
Open Portfolio and choose the account or all accounts
Open Transactions
Click Export and choose Excel
methods.notes: Transactions include trades, corporate actions and cash transfers. Alternative: My Profile > Account reports > Account Statement > Excel. A separate Dividends report exists. Menu labels vary by region.

steps: Log in to the LYNX Client Portal
Open Performance & Reports > Flex Queries
Create an Activity Flex Query with Open Positions, Trades, Cash Transactions and Cash Report, format XML
Save it and copy the Query ID
In Flex Web Service Configuration, enable the service and generate a token
Paste the token and Query ID into the dashboard
methods.notes: LYNX runs on the IBKR Client Portal, and a third-party tracker says Flex Queries with a read-only token work as at IBKR. Not confirmed on LYNX's own help pages; same limits as IBKR Flex (token expiry you choose, max 365 days per query).

steps: Log in to the LYNX Client Portal
Open Performance & Reports > Statements
Under Default Statements, click Run next to Activity Statement
Choose the period or a custom date range
Download as CSV
methods.notes: Max 365 days per statement; last seven calendar years available. Multi-section IBKR-style CSV.
SnapTrade Personal (free) uses an UNOFFICIAL_API connector here: it logs in with your broker username, password and 2FA. Read-only. Terms-of-service and security risk.

steps: Open the BUX app menu
Tap Transaction history
Choose the date range and transaction type
Request the export; the CSV arrives by email
methods.notes: Comma-separated. Whether dividends appear as a transaction type is not stated. A monthly PDF report can also be switched on under Notifications and Email. No official API. Help article is about two years old.

steps: Log in to MijnMeesman
Go to Opdrachten > Transacties
Click 'Exporteren als Excel' below the table
methods.notes: Dutch labels; fund units and prices per order. Holdings and value are not in this file: use the Jaaroverzicht PDF (MijnMeesman > Documenten) or enter the value manually. No official API.

steps: Log in to MijnBND on the website
Go to Mijn documenten > Overzichten
Download the Jaaroverzicht or a transaction overview
methods.notes: Statement documents, not a data export; file format and app support not confirmed. No consumer CSV/Excel export found and no API.

steps: Turn on 2FA for your Bitvavo account
Log in on the Bitvavo website (keys cannot be made in the app)
Go to Settings > API and click Add new API key
Enter a name and your server's IP address for the whitelist
Tick only View access
Confirm with your 2FA code
Copy the API key and secret (the secret is shown once)
methods.notes: 1000 weight points per minute. View access covers GET /balance, /account/history, /depositHistory and /withdrawalHistory; GET /trades also needs Trade permission, so use /account/history with a read-only key.

steps: Log in on the Bitvavo website
Open Transaction history
Click Export (top right)
Choose the current year, a previous year or full history
methods.notes: Trades, deposits and withdrawals. Max 30,000 lines (ask support for more). Annual balance statement PDF is separate.
Free in restricted mode (accounts you link yourself). PSD2 payment accounts only: balances and transactions, no investments. Current/payment accounts only; credit cards are out of scope.
GoCardless: existing accounts only (no new sign-ups since July 2025). Coverage for this bank was not re-checked.
Probably covered as a major NL bank, but not confirmed; business-only anyway.

steps: Log in to Internet Bankieren
Open the page to download transactions (Bij- en afschrijvingen downloaden)
Choose the account holder and a file format
Set the start and end date
Click the download icon next to the account
methods.notes: Formats: PDF, TXT, MT940, XLS or CAMT.053 (no CSV). Up to 18 months back. File language follows the Internet Bankieren language. Developer APIs are for licensed third parties only, not individuals.

steps: Log in to Internet Bankieren
Go to Zelf regelen > Overzichten en afschriften
Choose Overige overzichten downloaden
Download 'Overzicht Box 3 Beleggen Transacties'
methods.notes: For Zelf Beleggen investment accounts; file format and contents not confirmed. No positions export found.
Free in restricted mode (accounts you link yourself). PSD2 payment accounts only: balances and transactions, no investments.
GoCardless: existing accounts only (no new sign-ups since July 2025). Coverage for this bank was not re-checked.

steps: Log in to Mijn ING on the website
Open the payment account
Choose to download transactions
Pick a period and CSV format
Download the file
methods.notes: ING help mentions 'Puntkommagescheiden (CSV)' (semicolon) and up to 24 months back; Dutch headers and decimal commas. Exact personal menu labels not confirmed. Developer APIs are for licensed third parties only.

steps: Log in on the ING website (not the app)
Go to Beleggen and open your investment account
Scroll down and open Transactieoverzicht
Select Beleggingen, set a period (max 365 days) and click Toepassen
Click Download CSV
Repeat with Geld selected for cash movements
methods.notes: Two CSV files (securities and cash), Dutch only, max 365 days per file. Steps from a third-party importer guide.
Free in restricted mode (accounts you link yourself). PSD2 payment accounts only: balances and transactions, no investments.
GoCardless: existing accounts only (no new sign-ups since July 2025). Coverage for this bank was not re-checked.

steps: Log in to Rabo Online Bankieren on a computer
Go to Instellingen > Betaalrekeningen
Choose Transacties downloaden
Pick the account, period and CSV
Download the file
methods.notes: Statement language can be set to English. CSV, also camt.053. Credit card transactions are under Instellingen > Betaalrekeningen > Transactieoverzicht (up to 15 months). Developer APIs are for licensed third parties only.

steps: Log in to Rabo Online Bankieren on a computer (not the app)
Under Effectenrekening, click Portefeuille
Export the report as CSV
methods.notes: Positions with current prices for Rabo Zelf/Advies Beleggen. Transactions are viewable in-app but no transaction CSV was confirmed.

steps: Open the bunq app
Go to Settings > Developers > API keys
Tap Add API key and confirm
Paste the key into the dashboard (it registers an installation, device and session)
methods.notes: Official and free to use, but the key has full access (can make payments); there is no read-only key. Binds to the server IP on first registration; sessions follow the app auto-logout. Standard data endpoints allow about 70-140 requests per 30 s.
Free in restricted mode (accounts you link yourself). PSD2 payment accounts only: balances and transactions, no investments. Listed as 'Bunq (DE, ES, FR, IE, NL)' in the Oct 2025 changelog.
GoCardless: existing accounts only (no new sign-ups since July 2025). Coverage for this bank was not re-checked.
Listed only by a third-party tracker; business-only.

steps: Tap your profile icon in the bunq app
Open Accounting
Choose export statement
Pick the account, period and CSV
Download the file
methods.notes: Also PDF and MT940. One file per (sub)account. Web: web.bunq.com > account > Settings > export. Not available for unverified accounts.

Free in restricted mode (accounts you link yourself). PSD2 payment accounts only: balances and transactions, no investments. EEA Revolut accounts only (Revolut Bank UAB, e.g. NL/LT IBAN). A UK Revolut account is not covered because Enable Banking has no UK market.
TrueLayer lists this provider, but live access is for registered businesses only, so it is not usable for a personal dashboard. Provider id ob-revolut (UK).
GoCardless: existing accounts only (no new sign-ups since July 2025). Coverage for this bank was not re-checked.

steps: In the Revolut app, go to Home > Accounts and pick the currency account
Tap More > Statement
Choose the period and Excel
Tap Generate, then the export icon
methods.notes: PDF or Excel (no CSV found for personal accounts); includes Pockets; times in UTC. No personal API: Revolut's API is for Business accounts and licensed open-banking providers.

steps: In the app, open Invest
Tap More > Documents
Choose Stocks > Account statement
Choose the period (All time for the first import) and CSV or Excel
Generate and download
methods.notes: Use the Account statement, not Profit & Loss. Path is official; the CSV option comes from third-party importer guides. Crypto has separate statements.

steps: Turn on 2-step verification in your Wise account
Log in on wise.com in a browser (not the app)
Open Settings, then API tokens
Click Add new token, name it and choose Read only
Confirm with 2-step verification and copy the token
methods.notes: Personal accounts can create a token (Wise help centre); it lasts until revoked. For UK and EEA accounts PSD2 blocks balance statements with a personal token, so expect current balances only; transaction history via API works only for US, CA, AU, NZ, SG and MY accounts. Use the CSV statement for history.

Free in restricted mode (accounts you link yourself). PSD2 payment accounts only: balances and transactions, no investments. Wise EEA accounts only (listed for NL and other EEA countries); a Wise UK account is not covered.
TrueLayer lists this provider, but live access is for registered businesses only, so it is not usable for a personal dashboard. Provider id ob-transferwise (UK).
GoCardless: existing accounts only (no new sign-ups since July 2025). Coverage for this bank was not re-checked.

steps: On wise.com, open the currency balance or Jar
Select More > Statements and reports
Choose the statement type, period and CSV
Download (re-enter your password if asked)
methods.notes: Max 365 days per file; one file per currency. Web also offers XLSX, PDF, MT940, QIF, CAMT.053; app offers PDF, CSV, XLSX.

steps: Open your profile menu
Go to Statements and reports
Choose Holdings statement and a date
methods.notes: Units and value of Interest/Stocks holdings on the chosen day. File format not confirmed.

steps: Open Trading 212 (app or web) on your Invest or Stocks ISA account.
Tap the menu icon, then Settings.
Select 'API (Beta)' and accept the risk warning.
Tap 'Generate API key'.
Give the key a name and tick only the read permissions (account data, history, portfolio); leave order placing off.
Choose 'Restrict access to trusted IPs' and enter your server's IP, or choose Unrestricted.
Copy the API key and the API secret. The secret is shown only once.
methods.notes: Beta API (v0), HTTP Basic auth with key:secret, base URL https://live.trading212.com/api/v0. Only Invest and Stocks ISA accounts (not SIPP, not CFD); one key per account, so add the ISA separately. No stated expiry. Rate limits are per account: account summary 1 per 5 s, positions 1 per 1 s, order/dividend/transaction history 20 per minute. The 'API (Beta)' menu may be hidden until the account is funded (third-party report).
SnapTrade connects with a TOKEN, i.e. your own Trading 212 API key, so the direct Trading 212 API is simpler. The connector also allows trading.

steps: Tap the menu icon, then History.
Tap the export button.
Choose the timeframe and the data types (orders, transactions, dividends).
Download the CSV file.
methods.notes: One export per account (Invest and ISA separately). A single export seems limited to about 12 months (official for CFD; community report for Invest/ISA), so export year by year. The same report can be requested via the API (POST /api/v0/equity/history/exports).

steps: In Trading 212, open the menu, then History.
Choose Export and pick the Activity statement for your Invest account.
Select the full period since you opened the account and download the PDF.
Upload the PDF below.
methods.notes: For EU (EUR) Invest accounts without an API key. Positions, trades, dividends and interest are read from it and checked against the statement's own totals.

steps: Log in to eToro on the web.
Click Settings in the left sidebar, then Trading.
Scroll to 'API Key Management' and click 'Create New Key'.
Enter a key name, choose Environment 'Real' and Permissions 'Read'.
Optionally set an IP whitelist or an expiration date.
Click 'Generate Key' and enter the code sent by SMS.
Copy the Public API key and the User key. The User key is shown only once.
methods.notes: Public API launched Oct 2025. Every request needs x-api-key, x-user-key and a unique x-request-id. Keys do not expire unless you set an expiry date. About 60 requests per 60 s for portfolio, balance and history endpoints. Account must be fully verified; availability for eToro US accounts is not confirmed. Dividend detail via the API is not confirmed.
OAuth, read-only. SnapTrade lists has_reporting=false, so transaction history is probably not returned.

steps: Log in to eToro on the web (not the new eToro app).
Click Settings, then the Account tab.
Under Documents, click View next to 'Account Statement'.
Pick a date range and click Create.
Click the Excel icon to download.
methods.notes: Real accounts only. Excel has tabs such as Closed Positions, Account Activity and Financial Summary; open positions are not listed one by one, so holdings must be rebuilt from activity. Also reachable from Portfolio > History > Account Statement.

steps: Log in to the IG web platform with your live account.
Go to My Account > Settings > API Keys.
Enter a key name and click 'Generate new key'.
Copy the API key.
methods.notes: Only works for spread betting and CFD accounts. Share dealing, ISA and SIPP accounts return 403 'stockbroking-not-supported'. Login uses API key + username + password to get CST and X-SECURITY-TOKEN session tokens; there is no read-only key, so the dashboard would hold your full login.

steps: Log in to IG on the web.
Open History for the account.
Set a custom date range.
Download the history as CSV.
methods.notes: Menu path comes from user posts, not IG help. One user reported an empty CSV. Check share dealing and ISA accounts separately.

steps: Sign up for a free developer account at developer.starlingbank.com.
Open 'Personal Access' and link your Starling account by scanning the QR code in the Starling app.
Click 'Create Token' and give it a name.
Tick only account:read and balance:read. That is all this app needs.
Click Create and copy the whole token (it is long and shown only once). Paste it below.
methods.notes: Free, read-only token for your own account, with no 90-day reconnect. The balance includes money in Spaces. Tokens reportedly last until you revoke them (third-party sources).
TrueLayer lists this provider, but live access is for registered businesses only, so it is not usable for a personal dashboard. Provider id oauth-starling.
GoCardless: existing accounts only (no new sign-ups since July 2025). Coverage for this bank was not re-checked.

steps: In the Starling app, open the menu.
Tap 'Statements and documents'.
Tap 'Statement history'.
Choose the period and select CSV.
methods.notes: Only settled transactions; pending card payments are left out. Cash ISA has its own statements under the ISA's Manage menu.

steps: Go to developers.monzo.com and sign in with your Monzo email.
Approve the sign-in in the Monzo app.
Open Clients and click 'New OAuth Client'.
Enter a name, set the redirect URL to your dashboard's callback URL, and choose 'Confidential'.
Copy the client ID and client secret into the dashboard.
Log in through the dashboard, click the email link, then approve access in the Monzo app.
methods.notes: Personal use only ('not suitable for building public applications'). Full history is available only in the first 5 minutes after approval; after that only the last 90 days, so import history straight away. Access tokens expire after hours; confidential clients get refresh tokens. Pots via GET /pots. No read-only scope (token can move money between pots).
TrueLayer lists this provider, but live access is for registered businesses only, so it is not usable for a personal dashboard. Provider id ob-monzo.
GoCardless: existing accounts only (no new sign-ups since July 2025). Coverage for this bank was not re-checked.

steps: In the Monzo app, tap the three-dot menu on your card.
Tap 'Bank statements'.
Choose the date range.
Choose CSV as the format.
methods.notes: Includes Pots. Also available as PDF or QIF.

steps: Log in at hl.co.uk and open the account (ISA, SIPP or Fund & Share).
Open 'Transaction history'.
Set the date range.
Click Download and choose CSV.
methods.notes: No official API. Menu path and CSV option come from third-party guides; HL's own help mentions Excel or PDF downloads from the Transaction history tab. Users report a 12-month window per download and a truncated security code column (no GB00 prefix). The account summary can also be downloaded as a spreadsheet for current holdings.
SnapTrade Personal (free) uses an UNOFFICIAL_API connector here: it logs in with your broker username, password and 2FA. Read-only. Terms-of-service and security risk. Not real-time.

steps: Log in to AJ Bell on the web.
Click 'My account' (top right).
Go to Documents and statements > Transaction history.
Set the date range from account opening to today.
Download as CSV.
methods.notes: No official API. AJ Bell's FAQ confirms the 'Transaction history' page; the CSV download and exact menu come from a third-party guide. Dodl (AJ Bell's app-only service) export is not confirmed.

steps: Log in to vanguardinvestor.co.uk.
Choose Documents from the left-hand menu, then the Documents tab.
In 'Report generator', click Go and pick a document.
Click Generate.
Download it from the list with the arrow icon.
methods.notes: No official API. Steps are official, but the file format is not stated (likely PDF); no CSV transaction export was found. Quarterly statements are also in Documents.

steps: Log in to ii on the web.
Click Portfolio at the top.
Select Transaction history.
Set the date range to cover all transactions.
Click the download icon and choose CSV.
methods.notes: No official API. Steps come from a third-party guide (Sharesight); no official ii help page was found.

steps: Open the Freetrade app and go to the Activity tab.
Tap the upward-arrow button at the top right.
Tap 'All Activity'.
Save the CSV file.
methods.notes: No official API. App only. Covers everything since account opening: top-ups, withdrawals, trades (contract notes) and dividends. Transfers in/out from other providers and some corporate actions (e.g. takeovers) are missing.

steps: Log in at fidelity.co.uk.
On Account Summary, click 'Transactions and Reports'.
Choose 'Transaction history'.
Set Timeframe to 'Custom Date Range' and enter the dates.
Click Export (top right) and choose 'Export as a CSV'.
methods.notes: No official API. Covers all Fidelity accounts at once unless you filter by account. Also exports as spreadsheet (XLS) or PDF.

steps: Log in to InvestEngine on the web.
Click Reports in the top-right corner.
Build a custom report for the date range you need.
Download it as CSV.
methods.notes: No official API. InvestEngine's help article says custom reports download as PDF or CSV; the full step list could not be read (page blocked), and the report types are not confirmed.

steps: In the Moneybox app or website, go to Settings > Statements & documents > Statements.
Generate a new statement and choose the account and date range.
Download it, or tap the envelope icon to email it to yourself.
methods.notes: No official API. Menu path is official; the format is not stated (likely PDF), so it is not a practical import.

steps: Log in to Nutmeg.
Open Nutmail or your documents to find the quarterly statement.
methods.notes: No official API and no CSV export found. Statements are quarterly PDFs. Nutmeg now trades as J.P. Morgan Personal Investing.

steps: Web: open your account, click your profile icon (top right), then Settings.
Under Account, choose the statement type.
Pick the time period.
Click 'Export PDF'.
methods.notes: No official API. Help centre lists PDF only (account, income, capital gains, costs). In the app: Transactions > Statements > Download PDF. A 2022 blog post mentioned a spreadsheet option, not confirmed today.

Download the statement PDF.

Click Search.
Scroll to the bottom and click Download.
Choose CSV and click Continue.
methods.notes: No personal API. Statements are PDF only; CSV comes from the transaction list. A midata file (12 months, ending 30 days ago) is also available on desktop via Manage > midata download.

Choose your current account and open Transactions.
Use the midata download option.

steps: Log in to the IBKR Portal on the website. Go to Performance & Reports, then Flex Queries.
Next to Activity Flex Query, click + to make a new query. Name it, for example 'Dashboard'.
Under Sections, add Open Positions, Trades, Cash Transactions and Cash Report. Select all fields in each and click Save.
Under Delivery Configuration, set Format to XML (not CSV) and Period to Last 365 Calendar Days.
Click Continue, then Create. Open the query's info pop-over on the Flex Queries page and copy the Query ID.
Go to Flex Queries, then Flex Web Service Configuration. Tick Flex Web Service Status and click Save.
Under Should Expire After, choose the longest option (1 year). Leave Valid For IP Address empty unless your server has a fixed IP.
Click Generate New Token, copy it, and paste the token and the Query ID below.
methods.notes: A Flex token can only download reports, never trade. IBKR updates the report once a day. The token expires after the time you chose (6 hours by default, up to 1 year): generate a new one then, which cancels the old one. Trades older than 365 days are not included. In a linked/multi-account structure only the master account can see the token.

steps: Download and run the Client Portal Gateway (Java) on your own machine.
Open the gateway's local login page and sign in with your IBKR username, password and 2FA.
Call the Web API through the local gateway while the session is alive.
methods.notes: Individuals cannot use OAuth; they must run IBKR's local Java gateway and log in by hand, and sessions time out. IBKR Pro accounts only; 10 requests/second limit. Not suited to an unattended dashboard; Flex is the better route.
Two connectors: 'Interactive Brokers' (TOKEN, read-only, likely Flex query based) and 'IBKR' (OAuth, read and trade). The direct Flex query is simpler.
Plaid supports 'Interactive Brokers - US' for Investments, Transactions and Balance. Only the Trial plan (US/CA developers) is free.

methods.report_name: Activity Flex Query (CSV) or Activity Statement
steps: Create an Activity Flex Query as above with Format set to CSV.
Run the query from the Flex Queries page and download the file.
Upload the CSV to the dashboard.
methods.notes: Format options are XML, CSV, Text (Pipe) and Text (Tab). Period options go up to Last 365 Calendar Days per run, so longer history needs several runs. The exact 'run' button label was not confirmed.
Uses the official TWS API but needs TWS or IB Gateway running and logged in; overkill for a read-only dashboard.

steps: Create a developer account at developer.schwab.com and log in.
Request access to 'Trader API - Individual' and wait for approval.
Go to Dashboard > Apps and click Create App.
Choose the API product 'Accounts and Trading Production'.
Enter an app name, a description and a callback URL such as https://127.0.0.1:8182 (no trailing slash).
Wait until the app status changes from 'Approved - Pending' to 'Ready For Use' (can take a few days).
Open the app and copy the App Key and Secret.
In the dashboard, sign in once with your Schwab brokerage login to authorise the app.
methods.notes: No read-only scope: the app can trade. Access token lasts about 30 minutes; the refresh token expires after 7 days and cannot be renewed in code, so the user must sign in again every week. Reported limits: about 120 requests/minute (transactions about 60/minute), transactions call capped at 1 year per request.
OAuth (read and trade). 'After broker approval' for commercial apps; not confirmed for Personal keys.
OAuth institution; one active OAuth Item per user per app. Free only for US/CA developers (Trial plan).

steps: Log in at schwab.com.
Go to Accounts > History.
Choose the account and a date range, then click Search.
Click Export and choose CSV.
methods.notes: Third-party guides report up to 4 years of history online and a cap of about 1,500 rows per CSV. Positions can also be exported from the Positions page, but that path was not confirmed.
Logs in with your username, password and TOTP secret stored on the server; breaks when the site changes and may breach Schwab's terms. The official API (via schwab-py) is the safer choice.

steps: Log in at developer.etrade.com with your E*TRADE login.
Request an Individual sandbox key.
Complete the API Developer Agreement and the User Intent Survey.
Request an Individual production (live) key.
Copy the consumer key and secret.
Authorise the dashboard each day in a browser and paste the verifier code.
methods.notes: OAuth 1.0a. Access token expires at midnight US Eastern every day and goes inactive after 2 hours without calls (renewable until midnight), so unattended use needs a manual login daily. No read-only scope. An Individual key works with your own accounts only.
OAuth (read and trade).
Plaid page 'E*TRADE Financial' lists Investments. Free only for US/CA developers.

steps: Log in at etrade.com.
Open your account's transaction history.
Choose a time period.
Click Download and pick the spreadsheet (CSV) format.
methods.notes: Menu names changed after the Morgan Stanley migration; exact path not confirmed from an official page. Gains & Losses can also be downloaded as TaxableGLDownload.csv.
A Python wrapper around the official API, not a scraper; still needs the daily OAuth login.

steps: Log in at webull.com.
Click your avatar (top right), then Developer Console.
Go to Access Credentials > API Keys and click Apply for API Service.
Wait for approval (1 to 2 business days at the earliest).
Click Register an API Application and fill in the form.
Click Submit, then Generate Key in the Operate column.
Copy the App Key and App Secret from the pop-up (shown only once).
When the dashboard first connects, approve the SMS code in the Webull app (Menu > Messages > OpenAPI Notifications).
methods.notes: Free; needs an open Webull US brokerage account. Permissions are Market Data and Trading only, so no read-only key. The access token must be approved in the app within 5 minutes and lasts 15 days by default, then needs re-approval. Rate limits are on a separate page, not checked.
SnapTrade Personal (free) uses an UNOFFICIAL_API connector here: it logs in with your broker username, password and 2FA. Read-only. Terms-of-service and security risk.
Not confirmed.

steps: Log in at public.com.
Go to Settings > Security > API (public.com/settings/security/api).
Generate a secret key and copy it.
Paste the secret key into the dashboard; it swaps it for short-lived access tokens itself.
methods.notes: Free for personal, non-commercial use. The secret is exchanged at POST /userapiauthservice/personal/access-tokens for a Bearer token whose lifetime you set (validityInMinutes). No read-only scope documented. Limit 10 requests/second per account. Some pages mention a request form and approval email before the key appears. History rows lag fills; whether dividends appear in history was not confirmed.
OAuth (read and trade).
Not confirmed.

steps: Log in at app.alpaca.markets.
Use the account switcher (top left) to select your live account, not Paper.
On the Home page, find API Keys and click Generate New Keys (or Regenerate).
Copy the Key ID and the Secret Key (the secret is shown only once).
methods.notes: Keys do not expire but regenerating replaces them. Live keys start with AK and use api.alpaca.markets; paper keys start with PK and use paper-api.alpaca.markets. No read-only scope. Limit 200 requests/minute per account. Button labels vary by account.
OAuth. For commercial apps SnapTrade needs your own Alpaca OAuth app (approval up to about 4 weeks); not confirmed for Personal keys. Alpaca's own API is simpler.

methods.notes: Crypto only (Robinhood Crypto Trading API, US customers). Stocks, options and retirement accounts have no official API. Expiry and rate limits not stated in the help article.
